issue.title: Dirty hidden plans clone wedges the shared artifact-link write lane for all agents
issue.description:
The machine artifact-link write lane is refusing every write with
`plans: hidden clone has uncommitted or untracked changes; preserving
/home/bryan/.sase/projects/gh_sase-org__sase/repos/plans`.

Observed twice directly in this turn (2026-09-14 ~09:0x-09:4x EDT): `sase artifact link
add bead:sase-10v related bead:sase-10s "<reason>"` exited 1 with that error, and the
post-commit `sase stitch create --resume` finalizer printed `Could not drain
artifact-link read outbox: plans: hidden clone has uncommitted or untracked changes`.
Not a one-off: at least seven task beads from the last ~day (sase-10e, sase-10g,
sase-10i, sase-10n, sase-10o, sase-10t, sase-106) carry notes that typed related links
had to be recorded as prose because this same error refused the write, and sase-10e's
note says the hidden plans clone holds another agent's untracked links.

So one agent's stranded uncommitted/untracked state in the hidden host-owned plans
clone has been blocking every other agent's link writes and outbox drains for hours,
and nothing reconciles or quarantines that state — the lane just preserves the dirty
clone and fails. Worker should inspect what is actually sitting dirty in
~/.sase/projects/gh_sase-org__sase/repos/plans, recover or quarantine it, and then make
the write lane self-heal (e.g. commit-or-stash-and-quarantine the foreign state with an
audit note, or use a per-writer scratch clone) so a single crashed writer cannot wedge
the shared lane indefinitely. Related closed bead sase-ye covered the no-retry half of
publication stranding; this is the dirty-clone half.

task_type_fields.impact: Every agent's typed related links and artifact-link outbox drains have been refused for hours; relations degrade to prose notes on beads.
task_type_fields.location: ~/.sase/projects/gh_sase-org__sase/repos/plans (hidden host-owned clone used by the machine artifact-link write lane)
task_type_fields.repro: sase artifact link add bead:<a> related bead:<b> '<reason>' — exits 1 with 'plans: hidden clone has uncommitted or untracked changes; preserving ...'; the post-commit outbox drain fails identically.

evidence.note: Reproduced while creating live-acceptance evidence for phase sase-xe.16.11.7.15.7: 'sase artifact create --move --bead ...' created file:explicit:b79d37e46dc8755ef4d5daef but failed to attach it with 'plans: hidden clone has uncommitted or untracked changes; preserving /home/bryan/.sase/projects/gh_sase-org__sase/repos/plans'.

Independent reproduction during sase-zw.8 landing on 2026-09-14: sase artifact create with --bead sase-zw.8 created file:explicit:1b136cd32d914b18447bed0a successfully but exited 1 while attaching it, reporting plans: hidden clone has uncommitted or untracked changes; preserving the hidden plans clone. Exact durable audit reference recorded in the parent bead note to keep the remaining-work handoff reviewable. No hidden-clone files modified.
